Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing a reduced license fee for personal use trailers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to small trailer license fees; adding a new sectionto chapter 46.16 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In lieu of the license tab fees provided in RCW 46.16.0621, privateuse trailers of two thousand pounds scale weight or less shall belicensed upon the payment of a license fee in the sum of four dollarsand fifty cents, or if the trailer was previously licensed in thisstate and has not been registered in another jurisdiction in theintervening period, a renewal license fee in the sum of three dollarsand twentyfive cents, but only if the trailer is operated upon publichighways. The license fee shall be collected annually for eachregistration year or fraction of a registration year. It is the intentof the legislature that this reduced license fee shall be issued onlyfor trailers operated for personal use of the owners, and not trailersheld for rental to the public or used in any commercial or businessendeavor.
This act is effective with registration feesthat are due or will become due July 1, 2004, and thereafter.
